title: High-Rise Invasion
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: High schooler Yuri Honjo finds herself on the roof of a city of skyscrapers with no ground, where masked killers obeying a 'God Command' hunt the people trapped there. Allied with the killer Mayuko Nise, she fights to survive, find her brother Rika and learn why candidates are being groomed to become God.
life_message: It holds up survival through loyalty, quick wits and refusing to give up on the people you love.
